summary: Pause diagnostic capability discovery after authentication refusal and exercise diagnostic convergence inputs.

compatibility.detail: Completes the existing pause-until-re-pair policy for discovery 401/403 as well as submission; retained reports and public contracts are unchanged. Convergence input generation now handles the client subject family instead of silently skipping diagnostic kinds.

downtime.detail: No additional restart or coordinated deployment requirement.

manual.detail: No additional manual steps beyond re-pairing a refused client.

recovery.detail: Retained diagnostic reports resume with the replacement paired client.
